description: Spell text out using the NATO phonetic alphabet (Alfa, Bravo, Charlie and so on), or convert a phonetic spelling back into plain text. Spaces become (space). When converting back, common variants such as Alpha, Juliet, Xray, Niner and Fife are accepted; unrecognised words appear as #. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/nato-phonetic-alphabet/

direction.description: 't2n' text to phonetic (default), 'n2t' phonetic to text

text.description: The text or phonetic spelling to convert

name: hopi_nato_phonetic_alphabet

source_url.description: The tool's page on hopi.co.uk (cite or open to check the figure)
